Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hemoglobin and mild erythrocyturia may suggest some urothelial irritation. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
